This may reduce instruction cost without shared-memory tiling or target coarsening; the approximate reciprocal square root and altered accumulation require correctness and tolerance validation.

model_interpretation.claim: The current pair loop calculates j = k + (k >= i) for every interaction. Iterating directly over the two source ranges on either side of i should remove that per-pair comparison and index correction while visiting particles in the same order and leaving the floating-point arithmetic unchanged. The split loops may add divergence or code-size cost, so the controller must measure the official geometric-mean objective.
